{{field-1}}." :question/worked-solution "To find $\lambda ,$ we want to match the expression

$$
c=\lambda a+b.
$$

We are given that one of the components is $b.$ So, we first draw the vector $b$ from the origin. Then we complete the path to the point $C.$

![](images/b2/b2f5f00c7c968d98dd37e2e038b65d00b7cf5accb4aaf2bf2b801f15d3a27082.png)

Let $P$ be the endpoint of the vector $b.$ Then

$$
c=\overset{\to }{OP}+\overset{\to }{PC}.
$$

In $△OPC,$ we have:

- $PC=|a|$

- $\overset{\to }{PC}$ and $a$ have opposite directions

Hence, $\overset{\to }{PC}=-a.$

Additionally,

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =\overset{\to }{OP}+\overset{\to }{PC} \\  & =b-a.\end{aligned}
$$

Consequently, $c=\lambda a+b=-a+b.$

Since $a∦b,$ the linear combination can only be written in one way. Equating the coefficients of $a,$ we get:

$$
\lambda =-1
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["a4ea4a1d-d69b-5669-9edd-886adc6435b8"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "25dd4c6a-da11-5495-b232-31ee59481fae" :answer/id #uuid "25dd4c6a-da11-5495-b232-31ee59481fae" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\frac{1}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "72540c89-33d7-5fd2-a17a-6bf6fce3a0f7" :answer/id #uuid "72540c89-33d7-5fd2-a17a-6bf6fce3a0f7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{1}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "220d1dec-e944-5790-bc26-1f670fabc91b" :answer/id #uuid "220d1dec-e944-5790-bc26-1f670fabc91b" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5214182d-58e0-502d-9eb3-f4444325ea2a" :answer/id #uuid "5214182d-58e0-502d-9eb3-f4444325ea2a" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-2" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c88531be-efec-51d9-bba8-8f694c027453" :answer/id #uuid "c88531be-efec-51d9-bba8-8f694c027453" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "6e587eb9-3777-51a4-8ee6-74b29e1d0b17" :answer-field/id #uuid "6e587eb9-3777-51a4-8ee6-74b29e1d0b17" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["25dd4c6a-da11-5495-b232-31ee59481fae" "72540c89-33d7-5fd2-a17a-6bf6fce3a0f7" "220d1dec-e944-5790-bc26-1f670fabc91b" "5214182d-58e0-502d-9eb3-f4444325ea2a" "c88531be-efec-51d9-bba8-8f694c027453"] :answer-field/correct "5214182d-58e0-502d-9eb3-f4444325ea2a" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "ce5d8fd6-4de7-54d7-a57c-e25407daa7b1" :question/id #uuid "ce5d8fd6-4de7-54d7-a57c-e25407daa7b1" :question/problem "![](images/35/35b69ac4ee471e78265590690fdf41416bba6b025e5368f0305192a8d5179322.png)
